name: CyberCrow
summary: Adelaide dialup ISP + PC training/consulting; defunct ~2002 (APCC PTY. LTD. (Australian Professional Computer Consultants), ACN 008 103 419).

events.details: CyberCrow retail homepage (Adelaide) last captured Aug 2002; replaced by a blank "Untitled Document" placeholder from Sep 2002, later an Internode virtual-hosting holding page (2010-16).

refs.label: ABR: APCC PTY. LTD. (Australian Professional Computer Consultants)
APCC's company page is hosted inside cybercrow.net.au (/apcc/), describing APCC as an Internet access provider on CyberCrow's own domain.
APCC contact page on cybercrow.net.au lists the SAME 23 Braemar Tce Stirling address as CyberCrow's own contact page - shared premises/infrastructure.
ABR record for the company (Adelaide SA). 'Cybercrow' itself has no ABR entry; John Schiller appears as an associated person (trainer) on ISP listings.
